brief:
Shehab Wire reported that settlers, backed by Israeli occupation forces, have maintained a blockade of three Palestinian homes on Mount Ras al-Ain in Qasreh village, south of Nablus, for the 14th consecutive day. The siege has severely restricted the movement of residents and cut off supply access to the properties.

The prolonged blockade represents an intensification of settler operations in the area. Israeli occupation forces have provided direct military support to the settlers enforcing the restrictions, allowing the blockade to persist without interruption. The three families affected remain trapped within their homes as the siege continues into its third week.
